# Gateway to ai.market messages

Generated by `python3 scripts/gen-outbound-doc.py` from the valid golden vectors.
Examples are synthetic test data. The local signed audit log records each outbound body.

## `scan_report`

Identity-key audit envelope; successful, terminal and probe receipts use the separate local receipt key.
Decoded documents are Python-canonical JSON (700 KiB maximum); the whole audit frame remains at most 1 MiB.

### `registration`

```json
{
  "gateway_id": "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
  "image_digest": "sha256:1187327c6d0f0b0b19b33ab211a549023aa9a41f359c6d0a827d7bd99f8d5994",
  "key_proof": "HoscvPe9B887lAxdsjFZec1QE7GCd1DpqiSI_6H3nlTxtneZUViE9pZq9oxcw_zIRQ-eDGTKcuNZ6dAauwK-Dg",
  "op": "scan_report",
  "receipt_public_key": "IVL40Zt5HSRFMkLhXy6rbLfP-ntqXtMAl5YOBpiB2xI",
  "registered_at_utc": "2026-08-21T10:00:00Z",
  "registration_nonce": "AgICAgICAgICAgICAgICAgICAgICAgICAgICAgICAgI",
  "scanner_version": "0.0.0-test",
  "variant": "register"
}
```
